profile_text.body:
Andreessen Horowitz, also known as a16z, is a venture capital firm based in Menlo Park, California, according to its website. The firm was founded in 2009 and describes itself as investing in founders, innovators, and entrepreneurs building the future through technology. Its site carries the phrase "Software Is Eating the World."

The company's own description places it in Silicon Valley and frames its work as backing technology companies. No specific AI products are attributed to it in the available material, and no MCP servers are listed for it.

On the legal side, the litigation record associated with the company shows 270 cases in California.
